title: Close-up of multiple small green circuit boards with clear tubing and red-white tags
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

Three small green printed circuit boards are individually visible and distinguishable: one near the image center (angled), one lower right (in focus), and one at the left edge (blurred and partly cropped).

At least twelve separate clear flexible tubes are individually visible; they are concentrated in the upper and right regions of the image and have small red-and-white rectangular tags attached. (Some tubes extend out of frame or overlap; minimum visible count is reported.)

On the visible boards there are multiple small black circular connectors or fittings where the clear tubes attach; on the lower-right board at least four such tube-attachment points are visible, on the center board at least three are visible (counts constrained to clearly visible attachment points only).
Multiple purple insulated wires are visible, routed between boards and tying into connectors; at least three distinct purple wire bundles are visible.

Soldered metallic components and traces are visible on the underside of the green boards; a white circular blob of potting or adhesive is visible on the underside of the center board and another white blob is visible on the lower-right board.
spatial_relations: The three green circuit boards are arranged diagonally from left (rear, blurred) toward the right (foreground), with the central board suspended above and slightly in front of the lower-right board.
Clear tubes rise upward from the boards into the upper part of the image; many of the tubes are parallel and grouped together with the red-and-white tags located along their lengths.
Purple wires run downwards and between the boards, connecting the boards or their connectors; the lower-right board is closest to the viewer and partially occludes the wires behind it.
The leftmost board is out of focus and appears behind the central board; the central board is angled so its soldered underside faces the camera.
colours_and_materials: The circuit boards are green with visible metallic solder traces and components.
The flexible tubing is transparent/clear, and many tubes have small rectangular white tags with red borders or red markings.
Wiring visible in the scene is purple (insulated), and there are small black plastic connectors or fittings where tubes meet the boards.
White rounded blobs (likely adhesive or potting compound) are present on the underside of at least two boards.
uncertainties: Exact total number of clear tubes cannot be determined because several tubes overlap, extend out of frame, or are partially occluded; reported tube count is a visible minimum.
Individual characters or words on the red-and-white rectangular tags are not legible at this image resolution; no readable textual labels were confidently transcribed.
The function, brand, model, or specific type of the circuit boards, connectors, tubing, or white blobs cannot be determined from appearance alone and are not asserted.
Some connector counts per board are minimum visible counts because parts of the boards are out of frame or occluded; counts were not extrapolated to entire assemblies.
